questions.title: Who will be exercising the duties of governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state on August 21, 2026?
questions.background: Sinaloa's governor took a leave of absence on May 1 after being indicted by U.S. prosecutors on drug-trafficking charges. The question concerns who actually performs the governor's duties, rather than who retains the title while on leave.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Mexican government statements and contemporaneous news reporting identifying the person exercising Sinaloa's gubernatorial duties on August 21, 2026.
  • Resolution Rule: If the elected governor remains on leave, resolve to the acting governor. If the elected governor has resumed duties by that date, resolve to the elected governor.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The officeholder's full name.

questions.title: Which country will host USS Abraham Lincoln's next port call after August 1, 2026?
questions.background: USS Abraham Lincoln is a US Navy aircraft carrier on an extended deployment involving operations in the Middle East.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: US Navy announcements or contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press confirming the carrier's arrival at a port.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country containing the first port at which USS Abraham Lincoln makes a confirmed port call after August 1, 2026. Transit through territorial waters without a port call does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

questions.title: Which country will host Xi Jinping’s first visit to the Middle East in 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Chinese diplomatic announcements or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations, including Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first Middle Eastern country Xi Jinping visits in person during calendar year 2026. An announced visit does not count unless the travel occurs.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.

questions.title: Which DRC province will WHO identify as experiencing a surge in weekly Ebola cases in mid-September 2026?
questions.background: The Democratic Republic of Congo declared an Ebola outbreak in May 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: WHO public statements about the DRC Ebola outbreak, including statements quoted in contemporaneous reputable news reporting.
  • Resolution Window: Resolve to the province explicitly identified by WHO as experiencing surging weekly Ebola cases in its outbreak assessment publicly reported between September 10 and September 16, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the province.

questions.title: Which Brazilian Supreme Court justice, if any, will order Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues suspended during September 2026?
questions.background: Brazil’s Federal Police investigates federal crimes, and its leadership can be subject to judicial orders.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public orders from Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the justice responsible.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the justice who issues an order during September 2026 suspending Andrei Rodrigues from his position as Federal Police chief. If multiple qualifying orders are issued, use the earliest publicly announced order.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The justice’s full name. If no qualifying order is issued by September 30, 2026, answer “None”.
questions.accepted_format: The justice’s full name. If no qualifying order is issued by September 30, 2026, answer “None”.

questions.title: Who will win Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election?
questions.background: Okinawa is Japan's southernmost prefecture, where the presence of US military bases is a major political issue.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official results announced by Okinawa's election authorities, either directly or as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the winner of Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election is officially announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Which country will be the focus of a joint appeal to leaders at the September 2026 UN General Assembly to safeguard humanitarian aid and support a nationally led peace process?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country targeted by the September 2026 appeal from international humanitarian, development and civil society organisations calling on UN General Assembly leaders to protect humanitarian aid delivery, maintain essential services and support a nationally led peace process. Use the organisations' public statement or contemporaneous Al Jazeera reporting.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-23
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which official will Nigeria's interior minister suspend over the deaths of detained miners in Niger State in September 2026?
questions.background: Nigerian authorities have announced that miners died while being held in custody in Niger State.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Statements from Nigeria's Interior Ministry or reliable news reporting of the ministry's disciplinary decisions.
  • Resolution: Identify the official suspended by the interior minister in connection with the miners' deaths in custody in Niger State. The suspension must be publicly announced by 30 September 2026; calls for disciplinary action without an announced suspension do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The suspended official's full name.

questions.title: Which country will become the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords by September 27, 2026?
questions.background: The Artemis Accords establish principles for international cooperation in civil space exploration.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from NASA or the U.S. Department of State, or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country that becomes the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords on or before September 27, 2026. A completed signing is required; an expression of interest or an intention to sign does not qualify. A signing after that deadline does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

questions.title: Who will Morocco's king appoint as prime minister following the country's 2026 parliamentary election?
questions.background: Morocco's prime minister leads the government and is appointed by the king.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Moroccan royal palace's public announcement, as documented in reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person appointed prime minister and tasked with forming a government following Morocco's 2026 parliamentary election.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointee's name or commonly used surname.
questions.accepted_format: The appointee's name or commonly used surname.
